details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:345-346 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new script scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py, which agents.d/9485-dependabot-managed-wrapper-exclusions.md references, has no entry in the `## Scripts` section of docs/INVENTORY.md.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py (lines 245-248, 276-279/280) fails with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py" and "FAIL: agents.md:2081: references scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it". The tests-release-and-log-analysis job and the aggregate lint job then fail, which blocks the merge. anthropic and openai rate it BLOCKER; gemini stated no severity. anthropic notes docs/INVENTORY.md is outside the plan's files_touched grant, so the fix needs a scope extension.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:890-899, 2489-2496 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dependabot_sync step now skips the helper whenever DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED != "true", and when verification is off (UPDATER_VERIFY_RELEASE_MANIFEST=false, verified=skipped) that flag is never set. The verify job does not follow that switch: verify_release always attests the manifest, and verify_reproduce (line 2490 guard) runs the helper whenever the manifest lists it, so once a release attests the helper the two jobs disagree.
  WHY: For a consumer with verification disabled and a root github-actions Dependabot entry, verify_reproduce edits .github/dependabot.yml but the update job does not. scripts/verify_release_manifest.py `verify_pr_tree` (lines 703-705) then raises `derived_missing`, every updater PR is rejected or never auto-merged, and @stable updates stall. The comment at lines 892-895 and the "(also on `verified=skipped`), so the two jobs never disagree" claims in the agents.d and changelog fragments are wrong. Both reviewers rate it MAJOR. anthropic's suggested fix: guard line 2490 with `[ "${VERIFIED:-}" = "true" ] && [ "${DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED:-}" = "true" ]`.
- tests/test_sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:test_upstream_dependabot_config_covers_root_github_actions | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test fails because .github/dependabot.yml is excluded from the test environment/sandbox.
  WHY: gemini says CI job tests-release-and-log-analysis exits 1 on this test, which blocks the merge. gemini stated no severity; critical is inferred from that merge-block claim. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagrees: it says the test fails only in the pre-push sandbox, the PR diff adds .github/dependabot.yml with the asserted contents, and the CI checks on the head report no failure for this test.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Ship a `.github/dependabot.yml` in the synced template, or merge one into the consumer's own, that ignores the managed wrapper files." (issue #9485, Proposed fix, first bullet)
  expected_change_site: scripts/release_manifest.py::SURFACE_RULES (lines 74-98), plus the "Surface" docstring (lines 9-31) and the matching tests/test_release_manifest.py expectation (openai also names the update_workflows.yml dependabot_sync gate)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: SURFACE_RULES at scripts/release_manifest.py:74-98 does not list scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py, and enumerate_surface() (lines 276-305) emits only paths from those rules. Both helper paths gate on dependabot_helper_attested=true (update_workflows.yml:896-899 and 2490), so every consumer sync logs `DEPENDABOT_EXCLUDE_SYNC outcome=skipped reason=helper_unattested` and no exclusions are applied. The changelog fragment calls the SURFACE_RULES entry "the follow-up that switches it on". The PR's "Deferred scope" section defers only the actions/checkout pin bump (AD-3), not this activation. The Acceptance table shows test_sync_dependabot_exclusions.py as `unmet`. z-ai notes the deferral is disputed: the file is outside files_touched. anthropic notes activation also needs the verification-switch fix. Severity: BLOCKER per gemini/minimax/openai, MAJOR per anthropic/z-ai.
- requirement: Add scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py to the `## Scripts` section of docs/INVENTORY.md (repo script-inventory contract enforced by tests/inventory_parity.py)
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md `## Scripts` section, between `scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py` (~line 345) and `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` (~line 346)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in the PR DIFF or LAST RUN DIFF touches docs/INVENTORY.md, and grep finds no `sync_dependabot_exclusions` there. CI run 43773584522, job 132994684102 (tests-release-and-log-analysis) reports "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py" and "FAIL: agents.md:2081: references scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it", and the aggregate lint job then fails. tests/inventory_parity.py lines 245-248 enforce the contract. The files_touched grant excludes docs/INVENTORY.md, so the fix needs a scope extension. All three rate it BLOCKER.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:step dependabot_sync, lines 891-899 vs step verify_reproduce, line 2490 and step verify_release, lines 2195-2388 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The update job skips the helper whenever DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED != "true". When UPDATER_VERIFY_RELEASE_MANIFEST=false, verify_release_manifest (lines 381-388) writes only `verified=skipped`, so the update job never runs the helper. The verify job still attests the manifest, sets dependabot_helper_attested=true when the manifest lists the helper, and runs it in verify_reproduce.
  WHY: Once a release attests the helper, `_reproduced_changes` (line 526) picks up the .github/dependabot.yml edit, `verify_pr_tree` lines 703-705 raise `derived_missing`, and every updater PR gets a failed `ai-update-workflows/verify` status and is never auto-merged. The comment at lines 892-895 and the agents.d/changelog claims are wrong. Suggested fix: `if [ "${VERIFIED:-}" = "true" ] && [ "${DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED:-}" = "true" ]; then`.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:`## Scripts` section, lines 345-346; tests/inventory_parity.py lines 245-248 and 276-279 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py has no Scripts inventory entry, but agents.d/9485-dependabot-managed-wrapper-exclusions.md references it.
  WHY: CI job tests-release-and-log-analysis on head 65716d59 exits 1 with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py" and "FAIL: agents.md:2081: ...", and the lint job fails, which blocks the merge. docs/INVENTORY.md is outside files_touched, so the fix needs a scope extension.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Ship a `.github/dependabot.yml` in the synced template, or merge one into the consumer's own, that ignores the managed wrapper files."
  Expected change site: scripts/release_manifest.py `SURFACE_RULES` (lines 74-98), as a `("file", "scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py", True)` entry, plus tests/test_release_manifest.py
  Evidence of absence: SURFACE_RULES does not list the helper. Both gates (lines 896-899 and line 2490) require attestation, so every sync logs `reason=helper_unattested`. The gap is not deferred in "Deferred scope", and the fix also needs the verification-switch fix.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Not gaps: the action-version bump is explicitly deferred (AD-3). test_upstream_dependabot_config_covers_root_github_actions fails only in the pre-push sandbox, and CI reports no failure for it.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml step dependabot_sync, env RELEASE_MANIFEST_VERIFIED, is now unused. Use it in the skip guard (`[ "${RELEASE_MANIFEST_VERIFIED:-}" != "true" ] || [ "${DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED:-}" != "true" ]`). Estimated 1 line; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
